MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is the first tone mark? (1 mark)
   A. A flat line, as in ā
   B. A small V, as in ǎ
   C. A rising line, as in á
   D. A falling line, as in à

2. How is the sound ü written after the initials j, q and x? (1 mark)
   A. As plain u, as in qù
   B. As i
   C. As o
   D. As ü with two dots

3. Which initial is said WITHOUT a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. p
   B. t
   C. k
   D. d

4. Which sentence means "Who is this?"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我爸爸。
   B. 那是我哥哥。
   C. 我家有五口人。
   D. 这是谁?

5. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom"? (1 mark)
   A. 在床卧室。
   B. 卧室在床。
   C. 床在卧室。
   D. 床卧室在。

6. What does 六 (liù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Six
   C. Seven
   D. Eight

7. What does 九 (jiǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Nine
   C. Eight
   D. Two

8. Which sentence means "On Friday, go to the mosque."? (1 mark)
   A. 明天是星期四。
   B. 星期五,去清真寺。
   C. 星期天,去教堂。
   D. 我星期三去学校。

9. Which is an activity at a birthday party? (1 mark)
   A. 切蛋糕 cutting the cake
   B. 刮风 the wind blows
   C. 洗手 washing hands
   D. 上学 going to school

10. What does 号 (hào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Date (day of the month)
   B. They
   C. To play
   D. Gift

11. What does 水果 (shuǐguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Milk
   B. Fruit (as a group)
   C. What
   D. Drinks

12. Which sentence means "I drink tea."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是什么?
   B. 我喜欢喝茶。
   C. 我喝茶。
   D. 我早饭吃饼。

13. Which sentence means "What is this?"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是香蕉。
   B. 我早饭吃饼。
   C. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   D. 这是什么?

14. Which sentence means "I use my eyes to see."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用嘴巴说。
   B. 我有两只眼睛。
   C. 我用眼睛看。
   D. 我用耳朵听。

15. Which sentence do we use to name a weather picture? (1 mark)
   A. 这是太阳。
   B. 我叫太阳。
   C. 太阳在哪儿?
   D. 你好太阳。

16. What is back-chaining? (1 mark)
   A. Writing backwards
   B. Singing a song
   C. Reading only the first word
   D. Building a long sentence from its end

17. Which sentence means "The garden is on the right of the house."? (1 mark)
   A. 床在卧室。
   B. 沙发在哪儿?
   C. 花园在房子右边。
   D. 电视在哪儿?

18. Which word means "left side"? (1 mark)
   A. 下面 xiàmiàn
   B. 上面 shàngmiàn
   C. 左边 zuǒbian
   D. 右边 yòubian

19. Which word is pronounced tóngxuémen? (1 mark)
   A. 早上好
   B. 同学们
   C. 再见
   D. 叫

20. Which sentence means "There is a bed in the bedroom."? (1 mark)
   A. 门在左边。
   B. 沙发在哪儿?
   C. 卧室里有床。
   D. 客厅里有电视。

21. What does 在 (zài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Living room
   B. Door
   C. Kitchen
   D. Is at, is in

22. Which sentence means "Where is the television?"? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室里有床。
   B. 沙发在门旁边。
   C. 电视在哪儿?
   D. 床在卧室。

23. Which sentence means "On Sunday, go to church."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天星期三。
   B. 星期天,去教堂。
   C. 我星期六在家休息。
   D. 明天是星期四。

24. What does 七 (qī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Ten
   C. Six
   D. Five

25. Read the pinyin: zhè shì shénme? What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is this?
   B. I like to eat bananas.
   C. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   D. I drink tea.

26. What is skimming? (1 mark)
   A. Writing a text
   B. Copying a text
   C. Looking for one word
   D. Reading quickly to get the general idea

27. What can help you work out the meaning of an unknown word? (1 mark)
   A. The colour of the paper
   B. Nothing
   C. The size of the book
   D. Clues in the words and pictures around it

28. What does 里 (lǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Door
   B. Bathroom
   C. Inside
   D. To put

29. What does 电视 (diànshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Television
   B. To put
   C. Table
   D. Kitchen

30. In 我星期三去学校, what does 星期三 tell us? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Who
   C. When
   D. What

31. Read the pinyin: wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Wednesday.
   B. On Saturday I rest at home.
   C. On Wednesday I go to school.
   D. On Friday, go to the mosque.

32. What does 星期一 (xīngqīyī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Monday
   B. Three
   C. Five
   D. Today

33. What does 唱歌 (chànggē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Date (day of the month)
   B. We
   C. Candle
   D. To sing

34. Which sentence means "This is a banana."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喝茶。
   B. 这是什么?
   C. 这是香蕉。
   D. 我早饭吃饼。

35. Which word is pronounced niúròu? (1 mark)
   A. 牛肉
   B. 水
   C. 水果
   D. 晚饭

36. What does 茶 (chá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tea
   B. Dinner
   C. Flat bread
   D. Beef

37. What does 洗手 xǐshǒu mean? (1 mark)
   A. Brush teeth
   B. Eat
   C. Wash hands
   D. Clap hands

38. Which Chinese word means "small"? (1 mark)
   A. 小 xiǎo
   B. 不 bù
   C. 天气 tiānqì
   D. 雨 yǔ

39. What does 没有 méiyǒu mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today
   B. There is not
   C. Very
   D. Also

40. What does 沙发 (shāfā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chair
   B. Under
   C. Window
   D. Sofa

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." and "Today it rains." (4 marks)

42. Read the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马 and explain how the tone changes meaning. (4 marks)

43. Punctuate the sentences: 你好 (greeting), 我叫小明 (statement), 你呢 (question). Write the full sentences. (2 marks)

44. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: zhè shì xiāngjiāo. (2 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 祝 and 电视. (2 marks)

46. Write two foods from each group: fruit and meat, with pinyin. (3 marks)

47. Explain two things that help you read a sentence at a good pace. (4 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期天 and 早上好. (2 marks)

49. Write the stroke order of 大 in Chinese stroke names. (2 marks)

50. Give the Chinese for mosque and church with pinyin. (2 marks)

51. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." (2 marks)

52. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" and "This is a banana." (4 marks)

53. State three rules of stroke order and give an example of each. (3 marks)

54. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 送 and 床. (2 marks)

55. Describe how to make a birthday card from recycled materials. Give three steps. (4 marks)

56. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 旁边 and 您好. (2 marks)

57. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 小 and 哥哥. (2 marks)

58. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (3 marks)

59. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." and "On Wednesday I go to school." (4 marks)

60. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 午饭 and 快乐. (2 marks)

61. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 放 and 蜡烛. (2 marks)

62. Write the pinyin for 爸爸, 妈妈 and 姐姐. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A flat line, as in ā
   The first tone is high and level, so its mark is a flat line.

2. A — As plain u, as in qù
   After j, q and x the two dots are dropped, but the sound is still ü.

3. D — d
   d is unaspirated. t, k and p are said with a puff of air.

4. D — 这是谁?
   这是谁? (zhè shì shéi?) means "Who is this?".

5. C — 床在卧室。
   The pattern is thing + 在 + place.

6. B — Six
   六 (liù) means six.

7. B — Nine
   九 (jiǔ) means nine.

8. B — 星期五,去清真寺。
   星期五,去清真寺。 (xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.) means "On Friday, go to the mosque.".

9. A — 切蛋糕 cutting the cake
   切蛋糕 is cut the cake.

10. A — Date (day of the month)
   号 (hào) means date (day of the month).

11. B — Fruit (as a group)
   水果 (shuǐguǒ) means fruit (as a group).

12. C — 我喝茶。
   我喝茶。 (wǒ hē chá.) means "I drink tea.".

13. D — 这是什么?
   这是什么? (zhè shì shénme?) means "What is this?".

14. C — 我用眼睛看。
   我用眼睛看。 (wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.) means "I use my eyes to see.".

15. A — 这是太阳。
   这是 + word names what we see.

16. D — Building a long sentence from its end
   You start with the last part and add one part at a time.

17. C — 花园在房子右边。
   花园在房子右边。 (huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.) means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

18. C — 左边 zuǒbian
   左边 is the left side.

19. B — 同学们
   同学们 is pronounced tóngxuémen and means classmates.

20. C — 卧室里有床。
   卧室里有床。 (wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.) means "There is a bed in the bedroom.".

21. D — Is at, is in
   在 (zài) means is at, is in.

22. C — 电视在哪儿?
   电视在哪儿? (diànshì zài nǎr?) means "Where is the television?".

23. B — 星期天,去教堂。
   星期天,去教堂。 (xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.) means "On Sunday, go to church.".

24. A — Seven
   七 (qī) means seven.

25. A — What is this?
   zhè shì shénme? is 这是什么?, which means "What is this?".

26. D — Reading quickly to get the general idea
   Skimming gives you the main idea.

27. D — Clues in the words and pictures around it
   Context gives clues.

28. C — Inside
   里 (lǐ) means inside.

29. A — Television
   电视 (diànshì) means television.

30. C — When
   It is the time word.

31. B — On Saturday I rest at home.
   wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi. is 我星期六在家休息。, which means "On Saturday I rest at home.".

32. A — Monday
   星期一 (xīngqīyī) means Monday.

33. D — To sing
   唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

34. C — 这是香蕉。
   这是香蕉。 (zhè shì xiāngjiāo.) means "This is a banana.".

35. A — 牛肉
   牛肉 is pronounced niúròu and means beef.

36. A — Tea
   茶 (chá) means tea.

37. C — Wash hands
   洗 is wash and 手 is hand.

38. A — 小 xiǎo
   小 (xiǎo) means small.

39. B — There is not
   没有 is the opposite of 有.

40. D — Sofa
   沙发 (shāfā) means sofa.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà. 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Māma qí mǎ, mǎ màn, māma mà mǎ. Mum rides a horse, the horse is slow, mum scolds the horse. The syllable ma changes meaning with the tone: mā mother, mǎ horse, mà scold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pinyin, 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for explaining the three ma words.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! 我叫小明。 你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the two correct marks, 2 marks for all three.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is a banana.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝: zhù, to wish. 电视: diànshì, television.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fruit: 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo. Meat: 牛肉 niúròu, 鸡肉 jīròu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruit, 1 mark for meat, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read it slowly first; join the words together; speak at natural speed; keep the tones clear; record and listen back.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each explained point.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期天: xīngqītiān, Sunday. 早上好: zǎoshang hǎo, good morning.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 横, 撇, 捺.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all three in order, 1 mark for two.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì and 教堂 jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Top to bottom (三), left to right (好: 女 then 子), horizontal before vertical (十), 撇 before 捺 (人).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with an example.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 送: sòng, to give (a gift). 床: chuáng, bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: Fold recycled card or paper; decorate the front; write 祝你生日快乐! neatly inside; sign your name. Reusing materials reduces waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step and 1 mark for the recycling reason.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: 旁边: pángbiān, beside. 您好: nín hǎo, hello (polite).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: 小: xiǎo, small. 哥哥: gēge, older brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān. 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 午饭: wǔfàn, lunch. 快乐: kuàilè, happy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: 放: fàng, to put. 蜡烛: làzhú, candle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: bàba, māma, jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each with the correct tone marks.
